|strategy=By [mailto:searaptor@mindspring.com Wes Brown]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/speakwiththejedicouncil.html</ref>

If you're looking for a way to utilize the powers of the Jedi Council without making the Jedi Council Chamber your starting location, then look no further. Now you can pull a 3/0 location from Reserve and put a destiny 4 interrupt back into your deck. Then, when you draw this card later in the game, you can lose it to deploy a Jedi Council member from your Reserve Deck! I'll take two, thanks.

Combos:

Want to know what your opponent will be stacking on [[Sebulba]] his next control phase? Have a peek and decide whether or not to let him keep it.

Too good to leave out of almost any deck you build.
